text:
```yaml
name: Promote Dev Profile Images

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  cloud-dashboard:
    name: Cloud Dashboard CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Unit tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Promote dev profile images
        run: echo "Promoting dev profile images..."
```
